translation.name: Fúka Moodaanaki Kira Ufa Afaqínaasa Ufa

book.name: YOOHANEE
book.title: YOOHANEE Amiqira Fasaasa Ufa Yoohaneefa Akararinau.

content: Piratoofa Yuda maqannaasa ufa irisee Yisuna mareeqee narí sundia niminoo qimanniminau. Innee saamu atisaa sanda qusiranannai afaaqa turii umooqukamasaaqa qufaqa eedoo qimasee miqoo kai miqiqau.

Afaaqa turii qumooqukamaseeqa saatunanda fooqaana aukuseeqa saaeemma qumaree kukuqamasee Yisuna karaambaiqa qafee fee qimasee afisuamaqaqau. Qafee afisusee misa saasaakoona arira qamunna sundia qamunna fee qimasee afisuamaqaqau.

Sundiauqa nariqa sundia qamunna afisuamaqaseeqa anireeqa ataasa ataasa qimamaqee maaqi qiqau. Yuda maqannaa karaambaiqa afeeka anee mariana sia dauni kuqua miqidaqa ataasa ataasa qimariqau. Miqi qimasee misa nisaukusamu oori ariqau.

Misa miqi isoofanoo Piratoofa raudamakufanoo narí naambeeqai Yuda maqannaa moomoo marunnai qumureenoo qinau. Qinee Yisuna mareeqee inni nifusaa quqaanaura. Kuqira ainaina sia moo minaki marifaqa qinee qafaidaqa.

Miqi qimasoofanoo Yisufa saatunanda qafee afisirafa saasaakoona arira qamunanda rumbarafa raudamaki misa nifusaa kikiqinau. Piratoofa aiqama naaramasee qimanniminau. Innee qafaaqa. Doo mi fasiqafa maridanoo.

Amaana maqasaa Anutuna aanaiqikirausa uriqararausa faqa misa poorisauqa faqa Yisuna qafamasee firaakari faaqariqa qiqau, aunirira saqarisaa pirimma aruaqee qidaqa moomoo kari qimariqau. Piratoofa mina iriseenoo maaqi qimasee qimanniminau. Doo inneeqa kai mara maree aunirira saqarisaa pirimmannai aruaqa. Qinee mina qafaunanoo sia moo numoo minaki marifaqa qafaidaqa.

Yuda maqannaasa Piratoona ufa iriseeqa maaqi qimasee qimamiqau. Maasa sandufa maaqinna fasiqafa kuquannoo fee qidaqa. Mifa nariara Anutuna amaaku fee qimarifa marifaqa mina akiaqara arusaifanoo kuquannoo.
Piratoofa Yisunara Anutuna amaaku maridanoommi qimaseenoo firaaqoo rufianau.
Mifa kaifaa Yisuna afiqeenoo narí maaqaki oorureenoo irammirinau. Anee yaindari anuna fee qimaseenoo iroofanoo Yisufa sia ufa qimaminau.

Piratoofa mina qafamasee Yisuna kaifaa qimaminoo qinau. Anee sia fee qini qimaqiminnaree. Firimmannai aunirira saqarisaa arira aanoo qinindi maridanoo. Ani idukira aanoo irafa qinindi maridanoo. Anee sia fee minara iridanee.

Yisufa mina iriseenoo maaqi qimasee Piratoona qimaminau. Anee qiniara aanoo iannana sia aneennafau, Anutufa qinara kai maqee ani ufa ameemaanai quqaqisaifaqa maridaqa. Qinee minara maaqi qidaqa, qini qumare̱eqee ani asaukuki quqeemariasa misa numoo firaafa maridanoo anindi kaqikaafa.

Piratoofa Yisuna ufa iriseenoo firaaqoo mina aunduraki Yisuna idukiraree qimasee irinau. Yuda maqannaasa mina iriseeqa firaaqoo faaqarumasee qiqau. Anee maa fasiqana idukinaqa maasa aniara Roomma maqannaa karaambaiqinnai oonureeqa qimamianaura. Faiqí moo fannoo naríara karaambaiqee qimarifa Roomma maqannaa karaambaiqa namuqaa mariannoo.

Piratoofa misa ufa iriseenoo Yisuna afiqee madaanai ufa irimaru qaindanasaa ooqumarifinoo ufa irimaru qaindana aaqa ooni ausirirafa moomoo maruqoo qumu ooqumarifi ufa irimarinau. Yuda maqannaasa minara Kabatee qimariqau. Maasa ufakiqari ooni padiranee qidaqa.

Duna Anutuna qangiroo ainnaaqarara qoomaqa suqarafa mariannoo. Maqee suani qambaana marufanoo Piratoofa ufa irira qaindasaa ooqumarifi Yuda maqannaa qimanniminau. Doo maafa inni karaambaiqa maaqoo maridanoo.

Misa irisee faaqa quqasee kuqariraree kai qiqau. Aunirira saqarisaa firimmannai ariraree qiqau. Piratoofa mina iriseenoo Yisuna ariraree qusa qimanniminoo qinau. Innee kuqaa inneeqa karaambaiqa aunirira saqarisaa pirimmannai ariraree fee qidee. Miqi qufaqa amaana maqasaa Anutuna aanaiqikirausa uriqararausa Piratoona ufa irisee faaqa quqasee qiqau, maa fasiqafa sia maasa karaambaiqa maridanoo. Maasa karaambaiqa Roomma maqannaa karaambaiqa moodaa maridanoo mina auqu Sisaafa.
Piratoofa mina iriseenoo Yuda maqannaasa nisaukuki Yisuna quqanau. Inneeqa maree munusaifaqa sundiauqa aunirira saqarisaa pirimmannai aruaqa. Miqi qimasoofaqa misa Yisuna maree fiqau.
Misa Yisuna pirimmannai aunirira saqarisaa aru ufafa.
Yisufa Yeerusaree maqusaindari narí aunirira saqari akumaree fimarinau.

Fifiufanoo Eeburu ufakiqari faiqí nikiaqa amudaani fee qimaru amuaqunamusaa Koorookata amuaqunamusaa ooruree aunirira saqari maqai rumasee minasaa Yisuna mara airisee firimmannai Yisuna narí aunirira saqarisaa aruqapiriqau. Aruseeqa faiqí qaaraqanda mandainaina maraqanuqanda miqanda faqa nári aunirira saqarisaa dinni dinni naruaqapiriqau. Naruseeqa uqeereeqeeqa maqa aamara auquqoonaki rakiqaqau. Qaaraqanda dinni dinni Yisuna qambaanai rakiqaqau.
Piratoofa moo raufiqira saqarisaa ufa akara rumeeqeenoo narí rakira fasiqa moo amufanoo oorureenoo Yisuna akiaqa aunirira saqarisaa pirimmannai arinau. Mina akara oosana maaqimminoo marinau.

content.text: Maa fasiqafa Yisufa Nasareeteendaraafa Yuda maqannaasa karaambaiqa maridanoo.

content: Yisuna aru maqa maaqafa Yeerusaree aaqa adeedi marufaqa faiqí anaasee moomoo mina akara qafaida asaana rimariqau. Mi akarafa Yuda maqannaasa ufa moo auqu Eeburu ufakiqari faqa Roomma maqannaasa ufa moo auqu Ratinna ufakiqari faqa Kirisa maqannaasa ufakiqari faqa akara rinoo marufaqa asaana rimariqau.

Yuda maqannaa amaana maqasaa Anutuna aanaiqikirausa uriqararausa mi akarana asaana rumasee Piratoona maqusai oorureeqa maaqi qimasee aaqara ufa qimamiqau, saa sia Yuda maqannaa karaambaiqa fee qimasee akara rua. Kaqi narí kai Yuda maqannaasa karaambaiqee qimari fee qimasee akara ruaqaana.
Piratoofa irisee maaqi qimasee kaukaataqimasee qimanniminau. Qinee akara runafa doo saina mifa kai mariani.

Roomma maqannaa sundia qaara faqa qaara faqa Yisuna aunirira saqarisaa aruseeqa mina qamunna anaqi anaqi iseeqa nimana kai rainaqau. Yuda maqannaasa kisaaqa qamunna moodaa afisirana sia afu aina marufa marufaqa kaqi uqara foora amiqimasee auqirafa marufaqa sundiauqa mina qafeeqa doo amiqirafa marifaqa sia anaqia, kaqi kaatara foora sararamasee uriqarainafa maraani. Miqi qimasoofanoo ooqeenaa tamummaqarausa akara anoona mikari kambiqanau. Mi ooqeenaa akarafa minara maaqi qimaqoofa.

content.text: Misa qini qamunna raina rainamasee náriara náriara mareefaranoo. Kisaaqa qamunna moodaa mina sararamasee mareefaranoo.

content: Yisufa aunirira saqarisaa kuqirarifanoo mina aunirira saqari atukaki mina anoofa faqa narí auna qini qinoona faqa moo anaasee Karoopasana anaaqa Mariana amarafa Mariafa faqa moo anaasee Makadara maqusaindaraa Mariana amarafa Mariafa faqa minamusa miqoo kikiqiqa mariqau. (Qaaramoo anaasee Mariana amarausa kikiqiqa mariqau.)

Mirindari Yisufa qafoofanoo narí Yisuna faiqi namukiqari narí afaaqasaa aqoondi faqa qaaramoo anaasee mina anoona amarausa faqa kikiqiqa mariqau. Yisufa kuqiraridanoo narí anoona qafamaseenoo qimaminoo qinau. Oo qinnaqeefoo maa fasiqafa Yoohaneefa ani amaaku mariannoo qinee kuquananoo anisaa rakisiani.

Miqi qimaseenoo Yisufa quandakinoo narí afaaqasaa aqoondi maaqi qimasee qimaminau. Maafa ani anoofaikinoo marinana qinee kuquanana anee minasaa rakisia. Doo miqooqari mi fasiqafa Yisuna anoona afiqeenoo narí maaqaki soofanoo marinau.
Yisufa kuqu ufafa.
Yisufa nariara irufanoo aiqama ainaina doo maqee anoonaikufanoo moodaa ooqeenaa akara nammariara qimaqoofa mifa kai sia anoona kambiqaifaqee qimasee minara maaqi qinau.

Qinee nammariara didimarifaqee qufanoo miqoo uainna nammari taqu sundiauqa misa manda uainna nammari sukaqee maru nammarifa miqoo maruna faiqí moo fannoo eeqaufooqaana ateekasee minaki raaraamasee qisoopa saqari asaana undaqiseenoo minasaa rutaqueeqee mara muru Yisuna afaurusaa mundusoofanoo qumbifiqia namaseenoo qinau. Doo qini ainainirafa taikeenoo qimasee aunirira saqarisaa anuka rooraiqinoo doo kuquqaraasinau.
Faaqaana atoofeesaqaanda Yisuna aqaasanaki raquramu ufafa.

Kuqufufanoo Yuda maqannaasa uriqararausa Piratoofa narí maaqai marunnai oonuree maaqi qimasee qimamiqau. Duna sabata naaquqara sabata mariannoo. Maqee kai aunirira saqarisaa mariasa niku itairisaana dauni kuqufifaqa nikundamasee duna amiqimandee sabata maraanaura.
Piratoofa eedoo qufaqa sundiauqa oonureeqa Yisuna aaqa dinni marunna aiku itairisee moo dinni maruna Yisuna faqa kuquna aiku itairisaqau.
Yisuna aiku itairianee qimasee qafoofanoo doo kaaqa kuqinoo marufaqa sia aiku itairiqau.
Sundia moo fannoo faaqaana qumareenoo Yisuna aqaasanasaa raquraminau. Raquru amufanoo fidika faqa nammari faqa minakiqari aniranau.

Aniroofanoo mi ainainna qafee marufa minara akara rinau. Mifa narí ufara kuqaa anoonee qidanoo innee faqa kuqaa anoonee qiaqeera akara rinau. Yoohaneefa afaqanoo nidanoo miqaa maaqaa imarufanoo qafeemarinau. (Yoohaneefa maa akarana akara rumaseenoo narí auqu sia kooroo iraree qimaseenoo maa akaranaki nariara Yisuna afaaqasaa aqoondi maridee qinau.)
Maa ainainnausa Yisuna arunara ooqeenaa akara anoonaikianifeera kambiqanau. Mi ooqeenaa akarafa maaqi qimaqoofa maridanoo.

content.text: Sia mina amudaani moo fannoo raqaannoo. Sia uqanna moodaa raqaannoo. Miqi qimaqoo ufafa anoonaikufaqa sia mina aiku raqaqau.

content: Ooqeenaa akara moo maaqimminoo maridanoo.

content.text: Faiqí moo fannoo faaqaanannai asauku mundirana raquramisainaqa faiqí anaasee kikiqamambinaqa qafeefaranoo.

content: Mi ufafa faqa aunirira saqarisaa kambiqanau.
Yisuna akundoo ufafa.

Sundiauqa Yisuna raquramisoofanoo Yooseefaana amarafa Arimateea maqusaindaraafa Piratoona maaqai oonureenoo Yisuna iri aunirira saqarisaaqaraanara innaaru qinau. Mi Yooseefaafa Yisuna ufa irimarufa maridanoo narí aundurai kai iriseenoo sia faiqí nifusaa kooroo inau, kaqi marinau. Yuda maqannaa uriqararausa irifoo qimasee rufiamaree kukeeqakufanoo Yisuna iriara Piratoofunnai naríara oonureenoo innaaru qinau. Amanee qiminaqa maree munu akundaanauree qinau. Miqi qufanoo Piratoofa eedoo qimaseenoo aqiqoofanoo Yooseefaafa Yisuna iri aunirira saqarisaaqaraana tatumareenoo finau.
Nikoodeemusafa ooqai indaaru asukunaki Yisuna faqa ufa qiqiufa maridanoo mifa Yooseefaana dadaaqinau.
Mifa faiqí akunnimaqasaida nikundee maru marasinna moomoo uqanna maraseenoo qamunnasaa adieeseenoo minannai Yisuna afaaqa kukuqiqau. Miqanda nári maqannaasa oosana maraseeqa kukuqamasee akundaqau.

Yisuna aruqoo mina aaqa saqama marinau. (Yisuna aukuana narí maqannaasa maaqimasee madika indufusaida kuqufusa nikundee mariqau. Misa ooni firaana kasaaqa aamara auquseeqa minaki keeqafufaqa dinni dinni moomoo aamara auqiiseeqa kuqusa minakiaqa naadu naadu nikundee mariqau. Moodaa kai moo kari akundeeqa mina afunda taikoofanoo kaifaa moo fannoo kuqufaqa miqikai imariqau. Sia moodaa karifau nikundee mariqau. Moo kari moo kari nikundee mariqau.)

Mi saqamanaki ooni aamara fuka marunaki sia moo akundoonaki. Mi ooni aamarafa adeedi marufaqa duna maasa Yuda maqannaasa sabata naaquqarafa mariannoo qimasee kaqi kaqi ufaqa Yisuna iri ooni aamaraki munu akundaqau.
